project_targets.speech_measurement: WebRTC VAD mode 2; 30 ms frames at 16 kHz; detector reset for each of 66 scene windows beginning at the 4.586 s intro offset plus mix-timeline scene boundaries; denominator is the full finished MP4 duration.

series_intro.note: Recognizable shared intro structure retained; approved switch clicks and soft hum retained; no synthesized melody.

frame_timing.method: Each mapped act's real timeline interval is divided evenly among its stills; integer frame counts use largest-remainder allocation so the 53,773-frame body total is preserved.

subtitles.timing_method: Estimated within each TTS scene by text-character weight; not word-level forced alignment.

package.windows_batch_runtime_note: No Windows CMD/PowerShell runtime was available. The generated BAT, helper hash, embedded MP4 checksum, part names and sizes were statically checked; the same parts were reassembled and verified byte-for-byte with the executed shell restore path.

supporting_reel.caption_timing: estimated, inherited from S01E05 scene-level SRT; no forced alignment
supporting_reel.scope: Promotes the whole first season; remains separate from the long episode and does not overwrite pilot Reels.

visual_frame_samples: installation frame after the diagnosis act begins at 00:32:20
checks.visual_review: The 29 unique source stills were reviewed; five decoded final-video samples confirm the shared intro, the pre-install comparison before the repair action, installation only after the diagnosis act begins, the post-repair sequence and the closing co-hosts.
